independentReview.verdict: GO for bounded source and evidence; M3.3 remains open
independentReview.findings: No source blocker. Actual installed readback required and completed separately. Synthetic improvement is limited to grounded contribution answer; no general personality or speed claim.

comparison.scope: Synthetic records only; generated candidate context from actual adapter. Isolated tool-free comparison, no database/memory reads, conversation writes or messages. Same instructions/model; only self-state differs. Test identity, not full installed owner personality.
